reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: The amount rover takes from your hard earned money is outrageous I think it should be 10% not 20% of your pay

reviews.title: 25% fees are ridiculous
reviews.text: Dog walkers, pet carers, house sitters and pet hosts are paying an absolutely astronomical fee when they get paid from users bookings. Rover takes 25% and people are not as likely to tip 25% as one might hope. The app encourages service providers to set their prices so low that the hourly rate ends up being less than minimum wage. There is no reason the company behind the app needs to take 25% of all earnings. 5% would be reasonable for providing the platform, which is easy to use and does work very well. Most people would agree even 10% is okay. Over double that is a disservice to the people that keep Rover operating successfully.

reviews.title: Sitters POV
reviews.text:
Rover provides a valuable service to sitters by offering exposure to potential customers and making connections, that’s undeniable. What also seems to be consistent in my experience is that they squeeze us. There’s ways that they manipulate our behavior through algorithms and Star Status is a sitter who’s behavior is designed to get most engagement and bookings not necessarily providing good care. There’s always a pressure there, as if I work for their company but I don’t and they take a significant chunk off the top of whatever is earned.
There’s also a punitive approach they take towards people who want do not want to devote themselves to this work. I just got tagged with a “last minute cancellation on my profile for something 2 weeks away. And more importantly was only contacted about it the day before! I was not the party who created any time crunch and I informed them the next day as soon as I knew I couldn’t do it. 

I am a good sitter, trustworthy, and have great reviews….and yet both Rover and some clients treat me with suspicion or like I need to prove something and be over monitored. The arrangement is no longer working for me.

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: Businesses should inform you upfront that a pre-authorisation or security deposit will be placed on your card, whereas these guys just charge you an unexpected £24 for the luxury of having your card authorised!

reviews.title: NOPE
reviews.text:
Use any other way to get or provide pet services. they monitor your emails and then discontinue your account, when they get that information completely wrong! 
Totally insulting, especially to someone who has been providing exceptional pet care and had great reviews. 
I will not recommend Rover to anyone.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
I tried to use this app over the years, but it didn’t get any better. They charge way too much for the quality of the app and help they give. One can barely find where to edit their own profile description. The video calls are apparently gone, but people can’t exchange phone numbers inside the app either. I don’t understand how we are supposed to schedule anything without looking each other in the eye first. 
When you take the risk and meet the client in person, and choose to use another messenger as a form of communication (for obvious reasons), Rover invalidates your services for not being active enough with them. 
Now with new features we just have to go thru settings all over again, and it takes an hour to navigate it, or to confirm ID once more (like I changed mine from last time).
It’s just a mess and so complicated, I’m tired and therefore deleting the app now.

reviews.title: Rover App and Companu
reviews.text: I don’t know what’s wrong with Rover, but they’ve changed how they do things. The app allows you to find sitters, and I’m sure these sitters are great, but the app doesn’t let you know exactly where these sitters are located. They just tell you the city, so they could be 20 miles on the other side of town. Also, if you want to setup a recurring visit for daycare on Thursday you automatically get charged on the Monday prior to the visit. I canceled a visit and they were supposed to refund my charge but instead, they charged me twice for the one-day visit. If you try to speak to someone, there’s no phone number to speak to a person. Just a chat. It’s completely frustrating

reviews.title: Bug

Well since there’s no way to report a bug I guess a review it is!

Why can’t I scroll down under care instructions in the app?? It just freezes and the scroll locks. You’re telling me I need to go to a desktop to see care instructions?? Do some regression testing!!!

reviews.title: Longtime sitter leaving a review of rover
reviews.text:
Sitter POV: 

Rover is designed for Rover to make money that’s the end of the story. There is such an emphasis on sitters to have an extremely high acceptance rate, response rate, repeat clients, answering immediately, with no wiggle room on the sitter’s training or knowledge, including if their pet is aggressive to other pets in the home (they’ll dock the sitter’s status for not accepting despite it being in their bio of what they take. Their calendar system is awful set up to where you can’t fully actually set up your preferences or abilities for care. 

You can have your own dog or own cat in the home which is completely advertised, and the owner can completely overlook this and try and book with you and if you click pet was not a good fit… it marks to you declining to rover as you just don’t want it and destroys your acceptance rate, this is also true with if the owner changes their plans last minute/at all or doesn’t respond soon enough or make a payment soon enough it doesn’t allow you to be able to take new people as it kicks you off the calendar availability. 

Star sitter status is absolutely wild. Certain individual individuals refuse to give a five star review just due to their own personal viewpoint. If you give a sitter a four star review it kicks them out of search responses, and if that happens multiple times even if they gave exceptional services. They are no longer a star sitter. Which means the really good pet sitters that actually truly care are no longer a

reviews.title: UX/Product Feedback: Multi-account friction is causing customer churn
reviews.text:
As an app designer and Rover user, I love the platform's core concept, but the account management UX is causing serious user abandonment.
It is far too easy to accidentally create duplicate, fragmented accounts over time (Apple Sign-In vs. email vs. phone numbers). When users end up with multiple separate profiles and no intuitive way to link or merge them, the friction of dealing with standard customer support causes them to give up and delete the app.
The Fix: Implement an in-app "Link/Merge Accounts" flow. Let users verify a secondary email or phone number via an OTP (One-Time Password) to securely consolidate data.
Giving users a self-service way to resolve identity fragmentation will immediately lower support ticket volume and protect customer retention. I hope the product team considers this!

reviews.title: Rover lets people be flaky
reviews.text: It's a great concept, and I'm sure there are good people out there, but what's the punishment for backing out at the last minute? Happened to me twice.

reviews.title: UX is counterintuitive
reviews.text:
Not being able to filter by price and distance makes me never want to use the app. You can filter all these ancillary things except what matters. 
Also- do the sitters get as many reminders to confirm bookings, or respond to requests because it’s annoying how many reach out to other sitter notifications I get, but many sitters have just ignored my requests.

reviews.title: Ridiculously not user friendly
reviews.text: I have had this app as a dog trainer/ daycare/ boarder/walker & sitter for years. They now want me to reeducate myself in my trade to their terms. Haha they are the most uneducated & unprofessional imbeciles in the business & do not offer any protection to the workers at all. I just keep my profile up and open so people can find me. I wouldn’t recommend this company to anyone. They are subpar at best. And if I could leave zero stars I would because I’ve had issues and they just blow me off.

reviews.title: Save yourself AND your pet the trauma
reviews.text: I’m gonna start by saying I’m  sure there are some incredible sitters on here; HOWEVER, I have had nothing but horrible experiences with vetted and verified people on here. Rover needs to have a much better vetting system because my dog’s needs have never been met by apparently VERY ill-equipped individuals (with so many 5 star ratings???). Several items of expensive dog equipment that have lasted us years come back ruined or completely missing after a weekend away. I would absolutely not recommend this to anyone until Rover’s processes change DRASTICALLY. I should be able to feel comfortable leaving my dog in the care of “verified/background checked” individuals. I have found that by and large my dog is simply housed by the sitter and not actually taken care of, nor is he enriched. He is simply fed and taken potty but not given structure, playtime, routine, or even a quiet place to settle. After several extremely disappointing Rover encounters, I am finished. Deleting my account and supporting local businesses directly.

reviews.title: Will hold your bookings hostage if you use Apple Pay
reviews.text:
I booked four training sessions on Rover as a block using Apple Pay as my method of payment. Subsequently on the trying to confirm second, third and fourth sessions of the booking, they required me to enter a credit card, I had already paid for. That is literally holding the service. I’ve already paid for hostage. Requiring a credit card defeats the purpose of allowing Apple Pay as a form of payment. I shouldn’t have to put my payment in into multiple systems when I’ve already paid for the service that I’m trying to confirm.

Their workaround were for me and the trainer to do extra work to figure out how we could do it off-line, which is something that they specifically warm against customers doing in all of their official documents.
All of their responses are inconsistent. One time they were able to confirm a booking for me. After that, they acted like they couldn’t do that. 

Absolutely horrible customer service, abysmal experience. Would never recommend to any other pet owner. I actually have need pet services in the coming months but I’m never going to go to Rover again.

reviews.title: Service clients à fuir
reviews.text: Les consignes de la garde de mon chien n’ont pas été respectées, résultat : 100€ de frais vétérinaires. Le petsitter a demandé lui-même que je ne sois pas facturée de la garde du tout. Je n’ai été remboursée que partiellement pour les 2 jours de garde que mon chien n’a pas fait. Services à fuir, service clients à fuir aussi, inadmissible

They take 20% of your income, and charge owners an additional 10%-15%. They’re taking advantage of sitters and get rid of them on a whim.

reviews.title: Worst customer service
reviews.text: They have the worst customer service.  They are robotic and stubborn that do not accommodate a single penny-even when they are in the complete wrong.  Will never use them again

reviews.title: Don’t trust

As soon as I get there, Jocelyn N. doesn’t answer her Rover messages or texts. I’ve waited there for an hour with no reply. What a waste of valuable time and gas. Terrible first impression of this app. Go Book pet boarding with real pet boarders. Don’t use this app.

reviews.title: Overpriced and greedy
reviews.text: Rover kicked me off the app simply for asking owners for direct phone numbers to ensure better communication about their dogs. They charge outrageous fees and care far more about controlling every dollar than pet safety. Save your money and deal with sitters and owners directly.

reviews.title: It’s not just annoying this app seems CONCERNING for YOUR PETS SAFETY
reviews.text: Where do I start? Maybe first the fact that there’s a day option for dogs but not cats?? Seems kinda stupid. I mean, on the website on Google it seems you can drop them off at any given time “per night”, but on the current app I can’t seem to do that, and it’s confusing the ever living hell out of me. Secondly, the 1-star reviews. Why are there so many? No, actually, why is there so many that are SO similar and the fact that a good chunk of them are recent, like this month recent just proves this is like any other mobile app that says Thanks for your feedback but doesn’t seem to be changing the problem. Not to mention someone paid $500 for someone only for them to be horrible?? I mean come on rover. You need to seriously verify your people and make sure they have at least a year of experience. Don’t care how you do it don’t care when you do it, just do it because, with all the bad reports about scams and just bad sitters, it seems that your team doesn’t care about these people and you are just in it for profit not to mention more than one person said that customer service was not good so if you’re going to tell people to reach out to customer service maybe make sure they actually can do the job first? I was going to book for my cat to be watched for 7 hours, a SIMPLE 7 hours! But now I’m too scared to even try. It seems that the people on this app are either new and sketchy or have certain people they take good care of pets and with and others not so much.

reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: Shame, So many of the requests I have made have not even been responded to with a simple yes, no or maybe. Perhaps the app makers could consider that requesting or suggesting that sitters that respond to messages is  positive thing regardless if they are interested or not and that simple act of kindness might raise their profile status?

reviews.title: 20% Fee, Little Support
reviews.text:
Rover doesn’t just charge pet parents fees - it also takes 20% of sitters’ earnings. In return, we get a glitchy, outdated, extremely user-unfriendly app.

Pet parents often can’t complete or modify bookings properly, Rover support refuses to help, and the sitter is left spending hours trying to fix the problem. Meanwhile, while that booking sits pending, the sitter can be penalized by disappearing from search results and losing potential new clients.

And please don’t tell us the 20% goes toward support or improving the app. We’re not seeing either.

reviews.title: Pet Safety Violated, Rover Allowed Retaliation, Accountability Failed
reviews.text:
I trusted Rover with my dog’s safety. That trust was violated, and Rover’s handling of the incident was just as disturbing.

A Rover sitter used an e collar on my dog without my knowledge or consent. Throughout his stay, I received positive updates with no mention of behavioral concerns. I discovered the device still on him after bringing him home. Only after confronting the sitter did she acknowledge using it.

What followed was equally unacceptable. After I confronted the sitter and raised my safety concerns, she posted what I believe were retaliatory comments about my dog’s behavior—issues she never disclosed while caring for him.

I reported the incident to Rover’s Trust & Safety team and escalated it directly to a Vice President, who never responded. Rover issued a refund and explicitly assured me that the sitter’s comments would be removed from our profiles. That promise was never honored.

Even more concerning, the sitter appears to be active on Rover again. When I demanded answers, Rover repeatedly cited its Terms and Conditions instead of providing meaningful reassurance about how my safety concerns were addressed.

A refund is not accountability. Allowing what I believe to be retaliatory comments to remain after promising their removal is another failure of customer trust.

I have permanently deactivated my account and will never use Rover again.

To fellow pet owners: Please think carefully about whom you trust with your animals. My experience left me questioning n

reviews.title: The App is so bad
reviews.text: I’m a dog sitter on Rover, have been for years, and despite all the app updates, they just can’t get it right. The book acceptance process is complicated for customers and video uploading is archaic… such a hassle to send videos because the upload times out, the processing takes forever, and it’s just terribly slow. You’d think with all the money they take from the service they could pay to get someone to do a better job

reviews.title: Horrible app functionality
reviews.text: Connecting pet owners for sitting and boarding is what this service is most useful. I’ve been on both ends as a user and a service provider on Rover from nearly its inception and my biggest ‘pet peeve’ is how difficult the app makes it to send videos. It has gone through several updates and yet uploading and sending videos just keeps getting worse, where it takes forever to load. As a provider, I get great responses from customers who receive videos of their pets as opposed to photos, it makes a huge difference in the customer experience. Rover, PLEASE invest the 20% commission you charge us to make video sharing a smooth experience.

reviews.title: Expérience décevante, après pourtant 3 ans à utiliser l’application
reviews.text:
Très déçue par mon expérience avec Rover.

J’ai malheureusement le sentiment que cette plateforme privilégie davantage ses intérêts financiers que le bien être et l’accompagnement des personnes qui y travaillent.

Au moindre problème ou à la moindre erreur, les décisions peuvent être radicales, sans véritable écoute, compréhension ni possibilité de dialogue.

Il est particulièrement regrettable de constater ce manque de considération, alors que la plateforme prélève déjà des commissions importantes sur chacune de nos missions.

Nous contribuons pourtant directement au bon fonctionnement et au succès de cette application. Un minimum de respect, de transparence et de soutien serait donc appréciable.

À mes yeux, une plateforme devrait avant tout valoriser et accompagner sa communauté, plutôt que de donner l’impression de privilégier uniquement sa rentabilité.

Je ne recommande malheureusement pas Rover et conseille aux personnes concernées de se tourner vers d’autres alternatives.

reviews.title: Can’t leave a review if a groomer stands you up
reviews.text: Had a booked appointment and the groomer can cancel out of nowhere, no follow up to when they can reschedule. Horrible business practices and yet I can’t leave a review letting other people know this can happen with this particular groomer. First and last time using this Rover App!

reviews.title: Unhelpful Support and Unfair Policies for Sitters
reviews.text: Extremely disappointed with Rover’s support. During a minor pet injury, the emergency phone support was completely useless, instead of providing veterinary guidance or locating the nearest clinic, the rep just told me to Google it myself. On top of that, their guarantee program hides behind high deductibles that leave both sitters and owners completely unprotected for minor medical expenses. The app takes a large cut but offers zero real assistance when an actual emergency happens.

reviews.title: Getting requests outside of my availability times and still getting negative marks for it
reviews.text: Overall my experience with this app as a sitter has been good my only issue has been in my profile for certain jobs your able to select days and times you are available. I have it selected for I’m available everyday but Monday-Friday I’m only available after the 3:30 times slot.(I’m really not available till 5:30 but there isn’t an option for that) But even with that selected I keep getting morning drop in visit requests and when I say I can’t do them my acceptance rate goes down even though I have it marked that I’m not available.

reviews.title: Rover canceled my account
reviews.text: I had a poor experience with a house sitter recently. When I reached out to Rover about it, they helped resolve the issue, which I appreciated, however, they then canceled my account citing Section 4 of their terms and conditions despite the fact I did none of the things listed in Section 4. I reached out about it and they have so far ignored my request for clarity. Pretty frustrating when I did nothing wrong.

reviews.title: Lost my trust
reviews.text: Rover lost my trust after our dog was abandoned by two separate Dog Sitter’s for overnights. Then Rover was unresponsive with their emergency support people transferring us around the company and no one picked up the phone. This caused us deep, emotional stress and consternation as our dog was left alone and we were not even in the same state to come home in the middle of the night. I cannot believe a company could be so horrible to treat pet parents this way.

reviews.title: Central organization has Zero Control
reviews.text: I was a fan of Rovwr u til my most recent booking in which the sitter changed her pricing in the midst of my booking so I canceled my order. After the fact she offered to honor the original price but I’d already canceled and moved on. Since the central organization has zero teeth they allowed this woman to steal $90 from me for a booking that was in effect for literally two minutes. I can understand if there is some hardship but this was literally two minutes. I will no longer be using this service and I intend to steer everyone I k ow away. Their customer service does not exist as they have no leeway to make things right. Typical of 2020s America where thievery is not only allowed but applauded. Just another money grab. Customer service is a thing of the past. Sad. Beware of Brennan in New Orleaans.

reviews.title: Their UI just SUCKS!
reviews.text:
Why is it not possible to contact multiple sitters at once. Or to save your date AND pick up range and then message multiple people. 
I know it gives me the option to contact more people after sending out one message HOWEVER those people are not meeting the same search parameters as my previous search. (No dogs/cats of their own in their house). So why bother showing those people to me???? And why can’t I just go back to my search? Now I have to start the whole search again and put all filters in again to be able to see the list of potential dog sitters again. 
It feels like who ever is making this APP has never used it.

reviews.title: Punitive
reviews.text:
Rover is only there to protect themselves legally. Never report anything to them trying to get insurance coverage. Their strict policies have destroyed the businesses of well meaning sitters, myself included. 

Communicate first hand with your sitters that if any concerning behavior arises, let you know immediately. Despite this, I was blindsided, told my cat did very well, only to receive an email later about an incident learning he had bitten his sitter TWICE. This was incredibly abnormal behavior and it tears me up thinking about how distressed he must have been. 

Had I been informed, I would have pulled him immediately. But, I was left to pick up the pieces. They deactivated my entire account, which included my dog, not just deleting my cat’s profile. And left several dozen community members wondering where their 5 star sister (me), had gone. You’re better off coordinating with a local sitter or starting your own business.

This is not what it means to keep people safe— it’s punitive.

reviews.title: Horrendous
reviews.text: I spent $50 on the background check and I haven't gotten one single request. It's been a week now. I have adjusted my pricing and availability. I have made $0 and lost $50.

reviews.title: Grottenschlechter Support im Notfall
reviews.text: Im Notfall bekommt man nur eine Antwort von der KI. Der echte Support antwortet erst in 2–3 Tagen. Sehr schlechte Problemlösungskompetenz und Kundensupport!

reviews.title: Avoid at all cost
reviews.text:
App maybe ok but company is not safe! They are allowing unverified people to register as careers ! We nearly lost our pet due to negligence of their career. We raised issue with Rover and provided vet report. Rover response is that they cannot do anything and allowing career continue their service 
If you care about your pet please do not use this app

reviews.title: Rover ist nicht zu empfehlen - absolut unzuverlässig!
reviews.text:
An sich eine gute App, jedoch gibt es etwas, das mich außerordentlich nervt. Die Buchung kann einfach ohne Begründung storniert werden, obwohl die Sitterin sie nicht abgesagt hat - die Absage kam direkt von Rover. Zudem bietet Rover keinerlei Lösung oder Hilfe bei der Suche nach einem alternativen Sitter. Deswegen muss man den ganzen Urlaub verschieben. Mit Rover ist es sehr kompliziert, irgendetwas zu planen, da Rover jederzeit macht, was es will.

Überhaupt nicht zu empfehlen. Es gibt bessere Alternativen, bei denen man sicher sein kann, dass alles gut läuft.

reviews.title: For the amount of Rover Fees, I expected more
reviews.text: Owners arent vetted; No ID check, can submit whatever username they want (I have proof), and Rover still hasn’t fixed the platform to penalize owners for lack of response and actively penalizes sitters for metrics.

reviews.text: C’est si nul, j’ai payé 14€ pour « vérifier mon profil » et résultat bah rien il personne sur cette appli j’ai jeté 14€ à la poubelle.

reviews.title: Scammed out of $50
reviews.text: Got the app paid to have my account reviewed to become a sitter, it’s been 40 days since I’ve done that and I have yet to receive any single booking.. I want my $50 back 😔

reviews.title: Très déçu
reviews.text:
Tant que vous leur rapportez de l’argent, tout va très bien… surtout qu’ils ne se gênent pas pour se servir généreusement au passage. En revanche, dès qu’un problème survient, le discours change complètement : il semblerait que la responsabilité retombe systématiquement sur vous.

Et concernant les dégâts ? Zéro assurance, ou du moins une prise en charge qui semble inexistante dès qu’il s’agit réellement d’aider le prestataire.

En résumé : Rover est là pour encaisser sa commission, mais beaucoup moins pour accompagner ou protéger ceux qui font fonctionner la plateforme au quotidien.

Et pour couronner le tout, ils désactivent votre compte comme ça plus de preuves.

reviews.title: River rips you off
reviews.text:
I have used Rover for a couple of years and realised that they double charge you for booking. My sitter charged £23 and they add £4 to make it £27 then they charge me £31 claiming £4 for admin fees so effectively charging me £8 more! Plus when you contact them, the online service is atrocious. 
I had a double booking and asked them to cancel the new one. Instead the old one was cancelled. I have spent thousands of pounds on Rover and won’t use it again!

reviews.title: Aucune demande
reviews.text:
Je suis dog-sitter depuis 6 ans et cela fait 3 mois que je suis sur Rover. À ce jour, je n’ai toujours pas eu de demandes pour promener un chien ou garder un chat. Je ne comprends pas. 

Josselin Ricquier

reviews.title: Keine Löschung des Kontos möglich
reviews.text: Über die App an sich, kann ich nichts negativen Sagen. Trotzdem würde ich aus Datenschutzgründen davon abraten die App zu installieren. Es ist mir nicht möglich mein Konto zu löschen. Es taucht immer eine Fehlermeldung auf und auch über das Hilfecenter konnte ich Niemanden erreichen. Somit bleiben die Daten für immer da, wenn man sie einmal eingibt.

reviews.title: Scam

reviews.title: Très déçue par la gestion de mon compte
reviews.text:
J’utilisais Rover depuis plus d’un an en tant que cat sitter, avec de très bons avis et des clients réguliers qui revenaient réserver avec moi sur l’application.

Mon compte a pourtant été désactivé brutalement, sans avertissement ni demande d’explications, car un message a été interprété comme une tentative de faire une réservation hors plateforme. Or, dans cette conversation, je proposais simplement de réduire mon tarif directement sur Rover afin que ma cliente paie moins cher et que cela compense en partie les frais de la plateforme. Je n’ai jamais proposé de paiement en espèces, par virement ou en dehors de Rover dans cette conversation.

Ce qui me choque surtout, c’est la façon dont cette décision a été prise : aucune discussion préalable, aucun avertissement, et aucune prise en compte des conséquences pour ma cliente. Une garde devait commencer le jour même et, à cause de la désactivation, je n’ai même plus pu la contacter. Elle s’est retrouvée sans solution de garde pour son chat à la dernière minute.

Pour une plateforme spécialisée dans la garde d’animaux, je trouve cela particulièrement regrettable. Derrière chaque réservation, il y a un animal dont le propriétaire doit pouvoir assurer la garde. Une désactivation immédiate sans possibilité de communiquer avec les clients concernés peut avoir des conséquences importantes.

Après plus d’un an d’utilisation, de bons avis et des clients fidèles, je suis très déçue de cette expérience et de l’absence de dialogue. Je ne s

reviews.title: Difficult to use
reviews.text: Rover is a great concept, however, the user experience on the app is very poor. It makes me not want to use it. It’s not designed like an app and I constantly can’t find what I’m looking for. I would be happy to provide some suggestions!

reviews.title: I miss cat in a flat
reviews.text: The interface of this app is terrible and I keep getting requests from rogue people. Feels like a set up. What a shame. Cat in a flat was great. This is a mess.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Everyone we have tried to reach out to on this app has ghosted me. I have one small, house trained, easy to look after dog with no complicated needs or behavioural issues. We’ve never even received a polite decline, just straight up ignored. Disappointed.

reviews.title: Missing features
reviews.text: New to the app - can’t save or see favourites. Makes booking much harder …

reviews.title: Lacks development and improvement
reviews.text:
Rover’s user interface feels like its stuck in 2016. I have used the platform for several years, and there have been very few meaningful improvements. 
Its now 2026, yet the app remains unnecessarily difficult to navigate, especially for seniors and users with limited technical experience. Unfortunately, Rover doesn’t make up for its outdated interface with practical or user friendly policies. In fact, many of its policies create additional hurdles rather than solving problems caused by the platform’s own design limitations.
It is also surprising that a pet care platform doesn’t require owners to provide mandatory vaccination certificates or complete any meaningful pet screening process. Rover appears to have plenty of restrictive policies, yet lacks basic safeguards that would actually protect sitters, pets and other animals in the home.
Many of Rover’s policies seem designed primarily to reduce the company’s workload and liability rather than support the people using the platform. Simply adding Ai chatbot doesn’t count as meaningful product development. Seems the Ai chatbot was also added so Rover can work with lesser human support staff or reduce their workload.

Considering Rover takes 20% service fee from every booking, users should expect a modern, accessible interface, stronger safety standards, approachable and policies that genuinely support both pet owners and sitters.

reviews.title: Don’t expect any support as a sitter
reviews.text: As a sitter, don’t expect meaningful support from Rover if something goes wrong during an active booking. I accepted a booking that developed serious safety concerns, but Rover provided little practical assistance when I needed help most. Based on my experience, sitters are largely left to handle difficult pet parents and unsafe situations on their own.

reviews.title: Prélèvement de 14 € sans mon accord
reviews.text: Très déçue. Lors de la création de mon compte, j’ai renseigné ma carte bancaire uniquement pour recevoir les paiements. J’ai ensuite découvert qu’il fallait payer 14 € de frais de dossier. J’ai immédiatement annulé en fermant la fenêtre, mais les 14 € ont tout de même été prélevés. Je trouve cela très trompeur. J’attends maintenant un remboursement

reviews.title: 14€ pris sur mon compte bancaire sans consentement pour me connecter
reviews.text: Ils m’ont débiter de 14€ sur mon compte en banque pour aucune raison explicable quand je me suis connectée à mon compte pour etre dogsitter. Appli incompréhensible qui vous envoi sur des liens frauduleux pour récupérer vos informations personnelles.

reviews.title: Flaky sitters ditched me twice
reviews.text: What people do on this app is verbally agree to come, you confirm and pay but they don't at their end, they flake out for whatever reason and then you are left in the lunch not able to go on holiday and can't even leave them a negative review to warn others because it was "not officially confirmed" on Rover.

reviews.title: Impossible d’avoir de réservations
reviews.text: Tu payes 14 euros pour finalement jamais avoir de réservations et tu n’es même pas visible par les propriétaires d’animaux… déçue

reviews.title: Run money thief
reviews.text: This app just stole 14euros from my back account. when I realized there was a 14€ application fee I immediately canceled and deleted  my account. I never approved this transaction. To my surprise the next today I see a 14euros transaction. I can’t contact anyone since my account is deleted and the fee is non refundable.

reviews.title: Rover
reviews.text: Terrible app, cannot login or create an account. When eventually creating an account I could not receive my phone number confirmation as they never sent me one. No I am logged out and cannot gain access. Terrible app would not recommend

reviews.title: Had a terrible experience with one client.
reviews.text: Don’t expect to get many jobs after you go through the process and pay the fee. Services are too expensive (both sitter and client pay fees) so animal parents find help elsewhere. I’ve had more business from meeting people in dog parks. Also had the worst experience in 20 years of caring for dogs, with a family in Milton. App may help if you’re in a big city like Toronto.

reviews.title: Prélèvement non autorisé !
reviews.text:
J’ai voulu m’inscrire sur cette application, après avoir fait toutes les démarches d’inscription, on me demande de payer 14€ pour finaliser celle-ci et pouvoir utiliser les services.
Je refuse ce paiement, désactive mon compte et désinstalle l’application. 
Que fut ma surprise quand j’ai vu qu’ils m’avaient quand même débité ces 14€ sans mon accord !! C’est inadmissible !
A aucun moment nous sommes prévenus qu’il y a des frais d’inscription et on ne demande pas non plus de valider ce paiement.
En prime, mon inscription n’est même pas valide !!

reviews.title: Bring the original Cat in a Flat design back!
reviews.text: Please hire the designer from ex cat-in-a-flat back. Both the UX and UI design on Rover is terrible. It’s confusing and take much longer (more step) to finish one booking. Not sure why choosing time is mandatory, no prompt to leave review after sitting. The UI looks so dated and non under friendly. Hearing the same complains from someone who wants me cat sitting too. I think people stay just because they have cat sitters they trusted, or else I will be happily looking for other alternatives.

reviews.title: Can’t Register as a Dog Sitter
reviews.text:
I’ve been trying to register as a dog sitter from the UK for the past two days, using both the app and the website, but neither lets me complete my registration. It’s very frustrating because I can’t even get started. I expected the process to be straightforward, but instead I keep running into issues with no clear explanation.

Once this issue is fixed and I’m able to register successfully, I’ll be happy to change my rating.

reviews.title: Do not trust this company
reviews.text: We left our elderly but healthy dog with a sitter hired through Rover whilst we were abroad. She was not looked after properly and lost two kilos in a week. We were not informed of the situation until it reached crisis point and our beloved pet had to be given emergency care via our family members and was subsequently put to sleep. Social media seems to indicate this is not an isolated instance of sitters not taking their responsibilities to the full. Rover, whilst sympathetic, have offered no recourse.

reviews.title: Horrible people at Rover
reviews.text:
I was a 5 star sitter on the app for more than the past year that I had it. With 15 five star reviews. Every customer loved me. I loved them and the app. It was a main source of income for me. I live alone and recently moved to rent a full house in London Ontario to better accommodate dogs and not disturb neighbours. 
I recently boarded two dogs where I accidentally dropped one’s leash out on our walk, and the untrained dog ran without ever turning back. I ran my butt off for 30 minutes to ensure the dog’s safety, rather than turning around and letting him go missing or possibly get hit. My determination and level of care resulted in the dog’s retrieval.
That one Karen customer wrote the worst and most false review about me without providing any evidence, Rover started an investigation, I responded, and they canceled me from the app with zero specific reasons and without any supporting evidence. This was the thanks I got from the customer and from Rover, as a 5-star sitter. 
Hope and pray that accidents don’t happen to you, and that you don’t get stuck with a dog that was never trained, where the owner lies about them being house trained, so you have to clean up after them the whole time, and where the owner withholds pertinent care info from you, resulting in such risks and incidents for which YOU will be blamed and canceled with no warnings, no mercy, appreciation, consideration or forgiveness. Of course it’s the worst pet owners who are also the first to complain and blame

reviews.title: Get the job done but not great UX or coding
reviews.text: I found what I needed but I don’t like the app. The UX is not great. I can still get messages even after I archived a request…then what’s the point of that? Stopping me from messaging them? There are also buttons that have no feedback when I click it or save it. The worst part is I shouldn’t be able to pay before the sitter confirms but the button is still there and clickable…when the payment got declined with red error message I thought my card was locked or something…so stupid! Do better!

reviews.title: Lo peor que le pudo pasar a Cat in a Flat
reviews.text: Ni siquiera debería tener una estrella, la aplicación funciona pésimo, he tenido muchos problemas inclusive para verificar mi identidad, después de llevar mas de 6 años trabajando con Cat in a Flat; y no soy solo yo, sino que mis clientes también me han comentado lo horrible que funciona todo ahora que está en manos de Rover. Es una experiencia horrenda, estoy esperando a que me paguen los más de 200€ que me deben, con una alta posibilidad que no lo hagan, solo quiero deshacerme de este martirio de app

reviews.title: This app is getting worse
reviews.text:
This app used to be great but it isn’t anymore.
1. When sending booking request, it no longer shows the total price, only daily price is shown during searching. some times the price is surprising due to holidays / overtime stay /  puppy price etc and I had to explain to the sitter that too many fee is added making it over my budget (yes, not everyone has no budget for boarding their pets)
2. Last time I booked my two dogs with a new sitter. Sitter is great but she isn’t familiar with my dog’s behavior, and reported incident when my dogs had a small flight in the yard for a few seconds and nobody injured. And the sitter didn’t mention anything during the day or when I picked up the dogs. Rover sent a few emails into my spam box asking me to respond to the incident and finally locked my account, right before my next booking. I was really under pressure and disappointed. Rover’s customer service helped unlock my account in two days but their attitude was very arrogant, showing no empathy on what I experienced. When I emphasized this was a very negative experience and showed gap in sitter education, the customer service didn’t even responded to my email.

I used to be a big fan of rover but now I’ll consider not using the app going forward.

reviews.title: Cat in a flat was fine on its own

CIAF was absolutely fine before .... simple but done the job. Rover is known as a dog app... I regularly got new client's on CIAF, now that has stopped, luckily I still have old regulars. Such a shame. There is nothing good with this change

reviews.title: Traumatized

When we got there dogs started yelping and trying to get out of crates, 3 that were not in crates came at our dogs.. it was uncontrolled chaos. The house also was filthy and smelled like pee and the stairs were all chewed up. Never again… my mom and I took one look at each other and took our dogs and left. Using the app to sign up as a sitter - things constantly don't work. Trying to pay for ID check, over and over it says it hasn't gone through even though I have confirmed the payment with my bank. Very dodgy. 
If you try to get help it's just a bot, there is no number and ai continues even when it says you're through to a person. I'm looking elsewhere for a service like this as this isn't good enough at all.

reviews.title: Trop limité
reviews.text:
J’aime bien l’idée de Rover mais entre les frais d’inscription ( 14€ ) et les frais que chaque garde, c’est à dire que je garde un chien une semaine, 3 balades par jours avec accompagnement classique ( nourriture etc ) il la personne qui réserve les service payé 110€ et moi je ne reçois que 93! Je dois me déplacer 3 fois par jours sous une température au dessus de 30 degré, je pense sincèrement que ça ne vaut vraiment pas la peine. De plus certains clients se plaignent de tarifs trop élevés et me demandent s’ils peuvent me payer moins. 
J’aime beaucoup m’occuper des animaux mais le retour est vraiment très médiocre surtout au niveau de la rémunération.

reviews.title: No human support and only AI garbage
reviews.text: They don’t offer human support options no matter what you do you will be in a loop of AI hell telling you it’s willing to help but not actually answering your questions. Horrible app.

reviews.title: Manque de sécurité gardien d’animaux
reviews.text: lorsque nous gardons un animal que les propriétaires décrivent comme bienveillant mais qu’on se retrouve à être attaqué par lui, l’application ne protège pas du tout les gardiens mais uniquement les propriétaires vous êtes perdant si l’animal de quelqu’un vous attaque. J’ai même été suspendue à cause de cela alors que je suis la victime, la personne chez rover qui s’occupait de ce litige a grandement manqué de professionnalisme et n’était pas du tout objective face à la situation

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Terrible service from cat in a flat which had email reminders to leave people reviews and when bookings are due. Terrible to navigate compared to cat in a flat. With they had never integrated!

reviews.title: From star sitter to excommunicated
reviews.text: Terrible company, the dogs and pet owners loved me for my dedication but the rover staff did not properly screen their incoming bookings and exposed me to fraudsters and cult members who harassed me and caused me emotional distress.  I do not recommend Rover anymore.  They helped me realize that their lack of compassion put my valued talents in harms way.  This is one corporation that puts money first and puts you the star sitter last.  I hope they enjoyed the $5000 I made for them.

reviews.title: Banned from sitting after 5 years
reviews.text:
I used the service as a pet sitting for 5 years and in this time had a gleaming review page with every one being 5 stars.  I picked it back up the other day and reactivated my account following the birth of my son and was met with an email saying they were closing my account and the decision was final with no option to appeal. 

I had been a loyal servant to the app and always booked through the right channels when getting customers yet they claim I have been booking off the app. 

I supposedly have no right to appeal and all I’d say is be aware as all of your reviews and personal relationships with clients can be taken away at the drop of a hat without any proof of wrong doing.  BE VERY CAREFUL WITH THIS APP!

reviews.title: Umstellung von Cat in a Flat
reviews.text: Die Umstellung von Cat in a Flat zu Rover ist schlecht gelaufen. Unübersichtlich, umständlicher, Komplikationen für sitter und Leute die auf der Suche nach einem sind. Aktuell nicht empfehlenswert fürs Katzensitting, wenn man besseres gewöhnt ist.

reviews.title: Change of description
reviews.text:
Can you let us add a decimal place when setting a charging fee, for example £7.50 or do an option for £10 for one visit and £15 for two visits??
This was an option on cat in a flat

reviews.title: We are not welcomed there
reviews.text: Can’t paste password on login. We are really welcomed to use it

reviews.title: Déçu..
reviews.text:
Je suis petsitter sur des applications de garde d’animaux depuis des années, et jusqu’à présent je trouvais le système plutôt correct malgré les commissions appliquées. Elles étaient généralement raisonnables, autour de 20 à 30 € maximum, ce qui restait acceptable compte tenu du service proposé.

Mais aujourd’hui, je suis profondément déçu par ce qu’il se passe avec Cat in a Flat et Rover (Récemment relié).

J’ai obtenu une garde d’un mois complet pendant que les propriétaires partent à l’étranger. Le montant affiché de la réservation était de 323 €. Jusque-là, rien d’anormal. Sauf qu’après les “ajustements de paiement” liés au rapprochement entre les deux plateformes, je découvre avec stupeur qu’on me retire quasiment 65 € de commission, soit près de 20 % du montant total.

Le pire dans tout ça, c’est que cette information n’apparaît clairement à aucun moment dans le détail de la réservation. On accepte une garde avec un tarif affiché… puis on reçoit ensuite un e-mail nous annonçant qu’on touchera finalement 260 €. C’est incompréhensible et extrêmement frustrant.

Pour un mois de déplacements, d’allers-retours quotidiens, de temps passé auprès des animaux, d’investissement personnel et de responsabilités, je trouve cette commission totalement aberrante et disproportionnée.

J’ai essayé d’expliquer la situation au service client, mais aucune vraie solution ne m’a été proposée. On a simplement l’impression qu’il faut accepter sans rien dire.

À force de traiter les petsitters

reviews.title: Won’t let you add a preferred name as a sitter
reviews.text: My legal name is different from my self given name and Rover doesn’t have an option to add a preferred name. It’s 2026. Not having that option is pretty old fashioned.

reviews.title: App läuft nicht stabil
reviews.text: Die App funktioniert schlechter als cat in a flat und die Integration ist furchtbar. Zudem kommt die schlechte deutsche Übersetzung. Mein englisch ist gut aber die Übersetzung ist verwirrend

reviews.title: Changement de catinaflat to rover
reviews.text: Le changement m’a fait perdre mes clients… rover application compliqué à comprendre

reviews.title: Ridiculous fees
reviews.text: Overnight, Rover decided to take an additional 10% from my earnings as fees, which go directly to them. It’s getting ridiculous. They’re also double-dipping by charging both sitters and clients extra. Honestly, I’m considering switching apps, they’re taking almost half of our earnings.

reviews.title: À FUIRE
reviews.text: Je suis complètement déçue de cette application. J’ai voulu m’inscrire en temps que « dog sitter » et il était stipulé qu’il fallait que j’enregistre mes données bancaires. Je me suis fait débitée 14€ alors que je n’ai rien payé, et en aucun cas il était écrit quelque part que devenir dog sitter était payant. J’espère être remboursée 😡

reviews.title: Can’t see cat owners review
reviews.text: Since they merge with Cat In a Flat., I couldn’t see the review from the last order.

reviews.title: fees fees and more fees
reviews.text:
rover takes 30% from the sitters and an additional 11% from the pet parents.

If a sitter sets their base price at 50 dollars per night rover will charge the pet parents 56 dollars, then rover will pay the sitter 35. The sitter then has to pay taxes so the sitter is left with 30 dollars after taxes per night.

Rover is a greedy company, totally untrustworthy.

reviews.title: Manque de transparence sur les frais dog sitter
reviews.text: Application peu transparente. On vous débite 14€ de frais de dossier sans préciser clairement qu’ils ne sont non remboursables si vous ne validez pas votre profil et que ce dernier reste incomplet. Aucun mail de confirmation de paiement ni de suivi automatique sur l’avancement de la vérification n’est envoyé. J’ai dû prendre l’initiative de contacter le support client pour avoir des nouvelles et comprendre que mon profil était incomplet et que la vérification n’irait pas plus loin. Le support client m’indique que je n’aurai pas de remboursement. A fuir !

reviews.title: Fusion de Cat in a flat et rover décevante
reviews.text: J’étais sur l’app Cat in a flat en tant que catsitter depuis des années, tout se passait super bien et depuis la fusion je n’ai plus aucune garde. Le système d’annonces ouvertes à tout le monde qu’il y avait sur cat in a flat était bien plus pratique et rentable pour les catsitter, maintenant on doit juste attendre dans notre coin qu’un client nous contacte personnellement. De plus l’appli rover n’est pas du tout intuitive et fluide, avec des critères ou des titres mal traduis et trompeurs. Je regrette très fortement l’appli Cat in a flat…

reviews.title: Good but could be much better
reviews.text:
It’s a good way to connect owners and sitters but when looking for a sitter there are almost zero filters so it is very hard and frustrating. I have a reactive dog and am looking for sitters with experience with such issues but there is no way to screen for this or search with the keyword “reactive”. 
Fees are also quite high, and the sitters prices fluctuate a lot? Which has not to do with the sitters changing prices more Rover doing something shady. Like you will book for a service with a sitter for a set price and if you look their prices the second after (mind you offer hasn’t even been accepted yet) they will be noticeably higher for no reason.
Not from personal experience but a friend of mine was a sitter on Rover for quite some time and they were zero helpful when she had issues with a dog damaging her home while boarding with her. 
It’s a nice place to connect but for the fees it charges for its supposed support it’s definitely not worth using it in the long term once you found a sitter.

reviews.title: Cat sitters avoid
reviews.text: Unsuitable for cat sitting, customer service extremely lacking. Small adjustments impossible to make and have resulted in customer being charged over £100 in unnecessary fees. Cannot speak to anyone to resolve, merger with cat in a flat very unsuccessful. Takes a larger cut than cat in a flat did, for a worse service including no longer providing forms or insurance. Rubbish

reviews.title: Prélèvement de 14euros.
reviews.text: J'ai voulu m'inscrire pour devenir dog sitter mais en créant le compte sa m'a mis que je devais payer 14€. Évidement je ne voulais pas, donc j'ai quitter l'application mais en allant sur mon compte bancaire j'ai remarqué que j'ai été prélevé. Est-ce possible de me faire rembourser le plus rapidement possible car je n'était en aucun cas d'accord et j'ai besoin de ces 14€. Si je ne me fais pas rembourser je serais dans l'obligation de mettre une plainte chez les flics car ceci est un manque de respect total. Je n'ai que 15ans je suis mineure, sa peut aller très loin croyez moi.

reviews.title: Prélèvement de 14 euro!
reviews.text:
Je souhaitais simplement créer un profil. Lors du processus, il m’a été indiqué qu’un paiement de 14 € était nécessaire pour l’activer. N’étant pas intéressé, j’ai immédiatement interrompu la procédure et quitté l’application.

À ma grande surprise, j’ai constaté le lendemain un prélèvement de 14 € effectué sans mon consentement. Cette situation est inacceptable et constitue une pratique trompeuse.

Je vous demande donc le remboursement immédiat de cette somme.

Dans l’attente de votre retour, je vous remercie de votre compréhension.

reviews.title: Abysmal app. Nothing close to Catinaflat.
reviews.text: The app is Abysmal. Nothing close to how good the Catinaflat App was. The Layout, Design and overall ease of use is a real let down. The Callander booking system is of especially bad Quality. Please update the app.

reviews.title: Déçu de cette appli
reviews.text: Très déçu, j’ai voulu m’inscrire et sans qu’on me demande l’autorisation on ma souscrit 14 € de frais d’inscription, alors que je n’avais rien finalisé du tout, sans aucun accord, ni aucune demande, alors je m’étais dit au pire même si l’argent est souscrit, je pourrais continuer mon inscription, et en continuant mon inscription, ils m’ont redemander de payer 14 €, juste je trouve ça vraiment scandaleux. je ne recommande pas.

reviews.title: TIER RATE
reviews.text: I joined on March 20, and less than a week later the new Tier Rate was introduced. This major change was never mentioned when I signed up. The rate is unrealistically high and feels unfair, especially for new members. Had I known this was coming, I would never have subscribed. I would like a refund. UPDATE: this review was posted based upon untrustworthy information in Rover Terms of Service, which states specific cities for this pilot program, and I am not a resident in none of the cities on the list, so they don’t follow their own contract. I have officially denied permission for adding me to this program through customer service and they’ve promised to contact me in 24-72 h, it’s been 4 days and no response. UPDATE: April 3, after a week of trying to resolve this matter with customer service, they refuse to provide with requested information which raises legal concerns of their actions. UPDATE APRIL 6: rover has completely ignored this issue and just keeps sending general scripted emails with screenshots of the Terms of Service instead of proper requested documentation. They are not complying with the Terms of Service presented on the website neither. APPLYING THIS TIER RATE to my account is completely illegal, stay away from this company fallow Sitters.

reviews.title: Daylight Robbery if your original request is cancelled
reviews.text: So the original sitter I booked cancelled because of an health issue. When I tried to book someone else the prices doubled I.e trying to make up for cancellation. On browser you can still see the original prices while the app shows me double. Soo much for price transparency.

reviews.title: Arnaque
reviews.text: Je voulais être pet sitter et il fait payer 14€ pour vérifier les infos. Je n’ai pas cliquer sur valider qu’ils m’avaient déjà débiter. De plus désormaiso ils me redemandent de payer alors que je suis déjà débitée. Ils me redonnent les 14€ puis me les reprennent je n’ai jamais appuyé sur procéder au paiement. Je n’ai pourtant pas de compte valider

reviews.title: App needs work
reviews.text: Just downloaded the app and couldn’t get past first part without errors. Website has bugs too. Great service but can’t book or communicate with sitters due to tech issues.

reviews.title: The new Tier program SUCKS
reviews.text: Rover is getting REALLY greedy. Not only are their fees insane, but now they’ve introduced a new “tier system” so that we earn even less.

reviews.title: Rover do not carry out checks on their sitters
reviews.text: I have just found out that a verified and ‘recommended’ dog sitter that I used in December has been convicted of raping children. This case had been happening for 2 years! The sitter should not have been on rover, they clearly do not carry out any background checks. I feel sick thinking about what might’ve happened in his house with my dog around. Do not use Rover. I will not be using any of these apps ever again.

reviews.title: Attention frais injustifiée
reviews.text: C’est une catastrophe que ça soit sur les frais ou sur leur SAV ou ce qu’ils appellent service client , le petsitter m’a facturé des frais car je viens chercher mon chien plutôt en sachant que j’ai payé également la journée , des frais que je n’ai jamais accepté , mais Rover les prélève automatiquement et sans mon accord ,c’est du vol , leur service client ne répond pas sur whatsapp ou il t’ignore , ce n’est pas la première fois , je vais passer par un avocat

reviews.title: Locked out
reviews.text: I loved this app. The sitters took really good care of my dogs. But the app kicked me out and accused me of not paying my sitters. When I supplied proof through my banking statements they refused to investigate unless I paid.

reviews.title: This app sucks
reviews.text: It doesn’t work

reviews.title: Terrible App
reviews.text: Very expensive as well

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: I’m not paying you $50 to do a back round check that’s an employer expense not a employee expense

reviews.title: Appalling customer service
reviews.text: Been trying to sort out some payment errors with Rover for over a month now, with no solution on their end. I’ve sent screen shots and broken down the payment issues in detail - sloppy responses from what sounds like AI, from many Rover representative / AI, as msgs aren’t even read or interpreted properly. I have my rates set at £18 for drop ins, which Rover automatically dropped with a £3 deduction to £15, then again after I received my final payment. So double the usual booking fee. This has happened for the last 4/5 bookings and also my holiday rates have not been applied due to a tech error on the Rover app. Feels very dishonest for such a large company and wholly unprofessional. Looks like I will have to take this issue to an employment tribunal, which is a shame as I have been on Rover many years with positive experiences with dog and cat owners.

reviews.title: 14€ dés l’inscription pour l’examen de mon profil dog sitter ??
reviews.text: Ils demandent 14€ pour l’examen de notre profil pour devenir dog sitter, et ils prélèvement automatiquement je n’ai même pas pu la refuser !! Sérieusement et niveau service client on fait comment ??

reviews.title: Not enough people
reviews.text: Everyone I’ve tried has either been a bot or declines saying they can’t do the services they offer (home sitting), not a terrible app just no one to service the requests.

reviews.title: Solde debité
reviews.text: En m’inscrivant pour être dog sister, l’application officiel m’a débitée de 14€ sans même me prévenir, impossible de trouver la source, d’annuler en plus des bug d’interface rendant la recherche encore plus difficile

reviews.title: Former Rover employee
reviews.text: Hi my experience with rover was not very pleasant and I would recommend you not use their service as a dog walker or as a client.

reviews.title: Can’t get a sitter in the USA when you’re traveling
reviews.text: I used to be able to book a sitter from Canada in the US when traveling, now even the helper told me it’s not possible; i need to move in the US to get a sitter for my dog while traveling! Completely useless! Won’t be using it again

reviews.title: Zero trust
reviews.text: They fail to provide any real identity check - some users have multiple accounts. They also refused to compensate for the financial loss caused by their negligence, putting my pet at real risk. Avoid!

reviews.title: Waste of time and impossible to delete
reviews.text: What a complete waste of time. The app matches you with potential dog walkers who are never available with the days or times entered. It matched me with about 20 people in the area none who were actually available or hadn’t updated their profile. I have been trying for 2 months to delete my account

reviews.title: 20$ to register as sitter
reviews.text: Also really buggy app

reviews.title: Caution when you make payments
reviews.text:
Please be cautious when making advance payments on this app.

An inexperienced pet sitter I found through this app canceled the reservation because my dogs had an accident in her home. I believed it was only fair to pay for the full 7 hours of daycare that were used, as well as the cleaning fee.

However, the pet sitter did not refund the 7-night booking fee and avoided taking responsibility by blocking all communication.

I was charged a total of $621.60,
and the support team does not protect payments even in such unfair situations.

reviews.title: Unsafe and Untrustworthy
reviews.text: I had a recent booking that put my pets and my home at risk. Rover’s support team failed to acknowledge these concerns, and no action was taken against the sitter responsible. This experience has completely shattered my trust in the platform. I will not be using Rover again, and I cannot recommend it to anyone who values the safety of their pets and home.

reviews.title: Zero protection for sitter
reviews.text: Rover support team don’t care about their sitters. Whether you got scratch, bitten from pets, stayed extra hours for deceasing pets, they dont care at all. No compensations, no kind words. And they are still charging 20% from sitter’s pay. Sitters are “ individuals business owner” and rover claim they have no liability over these matters.

reviews.title: Incohérence
reviews.text: J’ai reçu un mail comme quoi mon profil de pet sitter était vérifié mais sur l’app il est dit que ce n’est toujours pas bon. J’ai payé 12€ pour cela et rien ne matche. Je suis franchement dessus et j’attends de l’aide de la part des développeurs pour résoudre ce problème.

reviews.title: Fraud
reviews.text:
Please read before downloading the app! 
* do not sign up for this app or enter bank details! They have taken money out of my bank account, I haven’t even entered my ID to verify my age before they took the money! And on the app they won’t even let me remove/delete my bank account details  unless I add another bank!! DO NOT USE!

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text:
I had a very serious and upsetting incident with one of the sitters on this app. She neglected my dog, and I only found out because I saw everything on my home security camera. If I hadn’t checked the footage, I would never have known my dog was being poorly cared for.
Despite clear evidence, Rover only refunded one visit, even though the problem was much bigger than that. What makes this worse is that once I requested a refund, I was blocked from writing a public review about the sitter. That means other pet owners are left completely unaware of what happened.
This is extremely disappointing and irresponsible. An app that claims to care about pet safety should not silence owners who experience neglect, especially when there is proof. Rover’s handling of this situation made me feel ignored, dismissed, and deeply frustrated.

reviews.title: Disappointing experience
reviews.text: I tried to find a sitter during the holiday season, which was extremely difficult. Most sitter accounts did not have up-to-date information about their availability and could not take bookings, or did not reply, so I had to keep contacting others. In the end, the app blocked me from sending messages for two days, which prevented me from finding a sitter. On top of that, the service charges a 15% fee in addition to an already high cost.

reviews.title: Dont trust it
reviews.text: I booked and paid for an overnight stay for my dog w/one of Rover’s “Star Sitters”. The day came and the sitter was nowhere to be found. After requiring me to wait an hour to see if dude showed up, Rover’s answer to the problem was to ask me various questions already available in my profile to ‘help’ find me a replacement. If a service does not provide the only thing they purport to provide, then they aint much of a service. Delete

reviews.title: A fuir
reviews.text:
J’ai crée un compte . J’ai voulu me reconnecter mais impossible de recevoir un lien pour recréer un mot passe . Après avoir fais plusieurs fois la manipulation , je décide de creer un autre compte , pas de chance, la même chose sé produit .
Je contacte alors le support . Après 3 semaines d’échange casi journalier , je reçois des mails à chaque de personne différentes me demandant si j’avais bien regardé mes spams, quelle était l’adresse mail de mes 2 comptes . Malgré le fait que je leur explique la même chose : je ne reçois rien dans mes spams , je redonne x fois mes 2 adresses mails … je reçois encore ce jour le même type de réponse . Résultat , je ne peux pas utiliser mon compte et je ne peux pas le supprimer .  Et ça dure depuis plus de 3 semaines et rien malgré une demande toute simple !!!!

reviews.title: Pas de demandes
reviews.text: Prenez pas d’abonnement ca sert à rien, il n’y a jamais d’offres. Plusieurs mois que j’ai payé l’abonnement et jamais eu d’offres.

reviews.title: Zéro réservation
reviews.text: Après payer 12€ pour avoir mon profil validé et attendre presque 15 jours pour qui ça soit fait, depuis presque 2 mois, et j’ai zéro réservation. Clairement, des arnaques

reviews.title: Fine when it works, awful when servers are down.
reviews.text: I’m a sitter on the app and its server has been faulty. Meaning I can’t log the walks I’m doing, essentially the apps poor performance reflects as poor sitter work. Customer service didn’t care.

reviews.title: Localisation incompréhensible
reviews.text: Je ne comprend pas pourquoi mon compte est au États Unis, alors que je suis à Paris, il m’est impossible de changer ma localisation. Est-ce qu’il y aurait quelqu’un qui pourrait m’aider ? Merci.

reviews.title: Unpraktikabel
reviews.text:
Diese App verbietet es sämtliche Nummer auszutauschen - man soll gefälligst über Rover telefonieren. Ansonsten wird man direkt geblockt. 
Ich hatte als Sitterin eine ältere Dame, die nicht mit der App zurechtgekommen ist, also hab ich ihr meine Nummer gegeben. Ansonsten immer brav geschrieben „bitte Kontakt über Rover halten“. Dafür wurde ich jetzt blockiert. Und das obwohl sie mit den 20% Gebühren sowieso schon extrem viel Geld für den Service nehmen. Einfach lieber andere Apps verwenden 👍🏼
